title: chore(sdui-parser): retire the objectui lockstep gate and its vendored record
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao7EJRrpBukNTDcMt2XiXQX1)_

Part of #25712 (item 3 = 2g, PR 3 of 3: retire the sdui-parser lockstep; lands FIRST by PM ruling; Tier H: `.github/workflows/lint.yml`).
Part of #25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 删掉让两份 sdui-parser 保持一致的 lockstep 门禁:`scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs`(1634 行)、它的记录 `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`、`check:sdui-lockstep` / `gen:sdui-lockstep` 两个脚本、`lint.yml` 里的那一步,以及 merge driver 台账和测量分诊表里指向它的两行。其余只改了指向它的注释。
- **为什么改:** 你在 2g 决策卡上裁定只保留 `@objectstack/sdui-parser` 一份(6418729849)。只剩一份时这个门禁就没有可比的对象了。
- **为什么先合这个:** 现在没有 `.objectui-sha`,门禁直接拿 `ui/packages/sdui-parser/src` 做对照。2g PR 1 合并两份实现时会单边改到它比对的区域,PR 2 删掉 ui 那份后它会直接拒绝。先退役它,PR 1 和 PR 2 就不会因为它变红。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 本 PR 合并后到 2g PR 1 合并前,两份解析器之间没有门禁守护。PR 1 紧接着合,它把两份合成一份,之后就没有第二份可以漂移了。不影响运行时、不发布任何包。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **你要做的:** 批准(Tier H:`lint.yml`)。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

Ruling 6418729849 on #25712 (2g decision card 6418466647, letter E + B) keeps `@objectstack/sdui-parser` as the one parser, deletes `ui/packages/sdui-parser`, and retires `check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` with its record. The PM ordered this PR first: with `.objectui-sha` gone, the gate's oracle is `ui/packages/sdui-parser/src` read in place (`oracleFor`, "pin absent, `ui/` copy"), and it REFUSES a tree with neither the pin nor that copy. So:

- 2g PR 1 (unify the body into `@objectstack/sdui-parser`) reds the gate if it edits the parse region, the diagnostic-code set or `validate.ts`'s containment branch on one side only;
- 2g PR 2 (rewrite the 122 importers, delete the ui copy) reds it unconditionally.

⚠️ **Between this PR and 2g PR 1 the two copies are unguarded.** A parser change landing in that window on one side only would not be caught. 2g PR 1 follows directly (4b seat, branch `claude/project-thread-6qe56u`) and removes the second copy's role; 2g PR 2 then deletes it.

## What changes

- Deleted: `scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs`, `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` (not in the package's `files`, so nothing published changes).
- `package.json`: `check:sdui-lockstep` and `gen:sdui-lockstep` removed.
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml`: the step `sdui-parser-stays-in-lockstep-with-objectui` and its comment block removed. No other step or aggregator names that id.
- `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`: the `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` row for `objectui-lockstep.json` removed (the file no longer exists). `ROOT_OWNER` keeps four other rows.
- `scripts/pm/measurement-claim-triage.mjs`: the row whose `file` is the deleted gate removed.
- Prose that pointed at the gate: `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (3 places), `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`.

### Left on purpose

- `packages/sdui-parser/src/parse.ts:49`, `src/validate.ts:53` (the `LOCKSTEP:` docblock), `src/__tests__/html-tier-manifest.test.ts:12`, `src/__tests__/inert-quick-add.test.ts:19`, and the invariant text of `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__sdui-parser__src__parse.ts.json`: 2g PR 1 rewrites these files (and `validate.ts`'s `acceptsChildren` docblock ships in the `.d.ts`), so editing them here would put a published-package change and a changeset into a no-publish PR and collide with PR 1.
- `ui/packages/sdui-parser/src/parse.ts:52`: deleted with the package in 2g PR 2.
- Dated measurements that name the old command as the condition of a reading: `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs:85`, `scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs:143`, the self-test literal in `scripts/check-pnpm-flag-spellings.mjs:884`, `.gitattributes:127`, `docs/audits/*`, and CHANGELOGs (release-owned).

## Verification

All readings at head `ce348aef` (base `365fe5ec`).

- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` → 97 families; all 97 run, all exit 0 (four dist-reading gates and the teardown self-test after a full `pnpm build` and the pinned-sha fetch). `--ran` reconciliation: 97 derived, 97 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. List: `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/2g-b/pr3-gates-ran-ce348aef.list`.
- **Push battery:** `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs` → `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2182 cases pass` (fast 1917 in 478 s, slow 265 in 1312 s), exit 0.
- **Governed predicate:** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-hrsgde` → GOVERNED (1 of 9 paths: `.github/workflows/lint.yml`), 1768 changed lines (+10 / −1758), under the 3000 human-merge line. Tier H.
- Not run locally (CI owns them): the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `Test Core` matrix.

## Changeset

None: the diff publishes nothing from any released package (`objectui-lockstep.json` is outside `@objectstack/sdui-parser`'s `files`). `skip-changeset`.
